scenario: Per-activation-key cooldown is the default per LCDB.7.1 — the cooldown key is the tuple of the rule's pattern bindings, matching refraction semantics. Two distinct facts that match the same rule produce two independent activations; cooldown applied to one does not suppress the other. Asserting Trig(v=1) and Trig(v=2) within the cooldown window fires both rules.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown 1_h:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
